messages:
maya: Heads-up — post-merge canary (release 3.6.1) shows p95 spike from ~120ms -> ~620ms around 02:12 UTC, deploy-bot flagged it.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary telemetry: p95 latency increased 420% vs baseline; error rate +0.4%; threshold exceeded (auto-rollback=true). Suggested action: hold canary, consider rollback. https://deploy.redwood/release/3.6.1

alex: I see traces — kv-cache miss rate jumped at the same time. Could be runtime kernel flag (kvcache-enh). Not comfortable letting auto-rollback touch dedicated pools.

sam: +1 on manual. Need QA confirmation before full revert. maya, can you confirm customer-impact windows?

maya: Impacting a small subset of EU hostnames only. No pager yet but a couple of product calls reported 504s.

bri: If we do manual rollback, prefer a partial traffic pin to 3.6.0 for dedicated pools then scale. Runbook reference: /runbooks/rollback-manual -> step 3b.

sre-oncall: I'm on-call and can run the rollback. Proposed quick plan: 1) Pin canary traffic to 3.6.0 2) Disable feature-flag `epic/kvcache-enh` 3) Monitor p95 for 10m 4) Post an update to status page.

maya: Agreed. Who will draft the customer-facing note? Quick suggested text: "We are rolling back a recent update due to a latency regression; service remains available but degraded for some customers; ETA 30m."

alex: I'll collect logs and paste a grep snippet for the team to inspect:

```
$ kubectl logs -l app=inference -n canary | grep "kvcache" | tail -n 50
[WARN] kvcache miss ratio spiked 0.02 -> 0.5 at 02:11
```

deploy-bot: Manual rollback queued by @sre-oncall. To execute, run `/deploy rollback release=3.6.0 --target=canary` or press the manual-rollback button in console.

sre-oncall: Executing now: `/deploy rollback release=3.6.0 --target=canary` — initiating stepwise pin and health checks.

(deploy-bot): Rollback started — 8 canary pods -> 3.6.0; health checks in progress; monitoring p95.

maya: Pinging #customer-success: drafting note and tagging impacted accounts.

bri: Observability update: p95 down to ~130ms within ~4m of rollback, error-rate back to baseline. Nice.

alex: Confirmed kernel flag revert will be in a follow-up PR; filing ticket INF-3425 with traces and timing.

sam: After 30m stable, propose a controlled rollout to additional regions with kvcache disabled, then re-enable flag gradually.

maya: I'll update release notes: "rolled back 3.6.1 due to kvcache-related latency regression; follow-up RCA pending." Adding postmortem owners.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 02:28 UTC. Canary p95 stable and health checks passed.

sre-oncall: Closing thread — follow-ups: INF-3425, release-notes update, schedule postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
